Booster Robotics K1 — the kid-size humanoid at the far end of the belt
Source: https://github.com/BoosterRobotics/booster_assets (robots/K1) @ 508cbee
License: BSD 3-Clause (see LICENSE), (c) 2025 BoosterRobotics
Used: meshes (.STL) + K1_22dof.urdf, posed and re-skinned for the Pond landing scene.

Notes:
  ~0.95m, 23 links, 22 movable joints. Legs are a coplanar two-link chain
  (thigh 0.1170m hip_yaw->knee, shank 0.2452m knee->foot).
  The STLs carry no materials, so the Pond palette is assigned by link name in
  build.js rather than read out of the source — see SPECS.k1.materialFor.
  K1 shares the T1's joint vocabulary (AAHead_yaw, Head_pitch, *_Shoulder_*,
  *_Hip_*, *_Knee_Pitch, *_Ankle_Pitch/Roll) with two differences worth
  knowing: the shoulder-pitch joints are named ALeft_/ARight_Shoulder_Pitch,
  and there is NO Waist joint — the hips hang directly off the Trunk, so the
  T1's "yawing the waist swings both feet" trap does not exist here.

  This robot is what the T1 was standing in for. When the landing scene was
  first built no K1 description was published and the T1 was substituted; the
  K1 is now public under a real licence, so it takes the slot it was always
  meant to have.
